title: French Composition
topics: The three parts of a composition

items.q: The statement “the restating of the question in one's own words to show that it is understood” describes which of the following?
o: Le genre de texte demandé
La reformulation du sujet
Le sujet
La consigne
items.s: La reformulation du sujet is the restating of the question in one's own words to show that it is understood.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La thèse?
o: a comparison used to make a description vivid, as a simile or a metaphor does
the central question the writer must answer through the whole piece
the position a writer undertakes to defend through a reasoned piece
the mark over a vowel that changes its sound or distinguishes one word from another
items.s: La thèse: the position a writer undertakes to defend through a reasoned piece. The other options describe L'image, La problématique, L'accent.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le sophisme?
o: the five stages of situation, complication, action, resolution and final state
a linking word such as ainsi that introduces a supporting case
the level of formality in a piece, ranging from polished to relaxed
a piece of reasoning that looks sound but is in fact faulty
items.s: Le sophisme: a piece of reasoning that looks sound but is in fact faulty. The other options describe Le registre de langue, Le connecteur d'illustration, Le schéma narratif.

items.q: Le décor may be defined as
o: the setting described in a passage so as to give the events a background
the summary of one's findings stated in the closing part
a passage that builds up a person's character and habits rather than their looks
the naming of one thing by another to which it is likened, without any word of comparison
items.s: Le décor: the setting described in a passage so as to give the events a background. The other options describe Le portrait moral, La métaphore, Le bilan.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La répartition du temps?
o: the putting right of the faults found in a draft before it is handed in
the free gathering of every idea that comes to mind before any of it is arranged
the allotting of the writing period between planning, drafting and checking
the rough first version written quickly and corrected before the fair copy is made
items.s: La répartition du temps: the allotting of the writing period between planning, drafting and checking. The other options describe Le brouillon, Le remue-méninges, La correction.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le style?
o: the admission of a valid point on the other side before answering it
a linking word such as donc that gives the result of a statement
the naming of something by a roundabout expression instead of its plain word
the way a writer shapes sentences and chooses words to produce an effect
items.s: Le style: the way a writer shapes sentences and chooses words to produce an effect. The other options describe La concession, La périphrase, Le connecteur de conséquence.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines L'explication.
o: the instruction that states how long a piece must be and in what form it must be written
telling in which the teller speaks as je and reports only what that figure knows
the way a writer shapes sentences and chooses words to produce an effect
the development that makes clear how a reason supports the claim it serves
items.s: L'explication: the development that makes clear how a reason supports the claim it serves. The other options describe Le style, La narration à la première personne, La consigne.

items.q: Which term is described by “the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read”?
o: La faute de conjugaison
La ponctuation
La faute d'orthographe
La faute d'accord
items.s: La ponctuation is the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La phrase d'ouverture?
o: writing that departs from what was asked and so fails to answer the question set
the final turn in which the complication of a story is settled
the opening address of a letter, such as Monsieur le Directeur
the first sentence of a block, which states the point it will develop
items.s: La phrase d'ouverture: the first sentence of a block, which states the point it will develop. The other options describe Le dénouement, Le hors-sujet, La formule d'appel.

items.q: Which term is described by “the opening sentence that catches the reader's attention and leads into the subject”?
o: Le bilan
L'introduction
Le développement
L'amorce
items.s: L'amorce is the opening sentence that catches the reader's attention and leads into the subject.
items.t: The three parts of a composition

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La faute de conjugaison?
o: a particular case brought in to make a general reason convincing
a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense
a letter written to apply for a post and set out one's fitness for it
the first sentence of a block, which states the point it will develop
items.s: La faute de conjugaison: a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense. The other options describe La demande d'emploi, La phrase d'ouverture, L'exemple.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le curriculum vitae?
o: a written report of what took place at a meeting, a lecture or an event
the central question the writer must answer through the whole piece
a written account of a person's schooling, qualifications and experience sent to an employer
the putting right of the faults found in a draft before it is handed in
items.s: Le curriculum vitae: a written account of a person's schooling, qualifications and experience sent to an employer. The other options describe La problématique, Le compte rendu, La correction.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le sophisme?
o: a piece of reasoning that looks sound but is in fact faulty
a block of sentences developing one point and set off by a new line
the word in the question that carries the weight of the demand and governs the whole answer
the opening sentence that catches the reader's attention and leads into the subject
items.s: Le sophisme: a piece of reasoning that looks sound but is in fact faulty. The other options describe L'amorce, Le paragraphe, Le mot-clé du sujet.

items.q: Which term is described by “a word or phrase such as cependant that shows how two statements hang together”?
o: Le connecteur de conséquence
Le connecteur
Le connecteur d'illustration
L'énumération
items.s: Le connecteur is a word or phrase such as cependant that shows how two statements hang together.

items.q: La faute de conjugaison may be defined as
o: a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense
a mistake in matching a describing word or verb with the noun it belongs to
the stage of collecting facts, examples and opinions to support the argument
the naming of something by a roundabout expression instead of its plain word
items.s: La faute de conjugaison: a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense. The other options describe La périphrase, La recherche d'idées, La faute d'accord.

items.q: Which term is described by “a written account of a person's schooling, qualifications and experience sent to an employer”?
o: La formule d'appel
Le résumé
Le curriculum vitae
La lettre formelle
items.s: Le curriculum vitae is a written account of a person's schooling, qualifications and experience sent to an employer.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le hors-sujet?
o: the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument
a reason offered in support of the position the writer is defending
a piece that sets out information on a subject in an ordered and neutral way
writing that departs from what was asked and so fails to answer the question set
items.s: Le hors-sujet: writing that departs from what was asked and so fails to answer the question set. The other options describe L'exposé, L'argument, Le genre de texte demandé.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le hors-sujet.
o: the use of the same word or structure more than once, which usually weakens a piece
writing that departs from what was asked and so fails to answer the question set
the development that makes clear how a reason supports the claim it serves
the position reached by drawing together the strong points of two opposing views
items.s: Le hors-sujet: writing that departs from what was asked and so fails to answer the question set. The other options describe L'explication, La synthèse, La répétition.

items.q: L'accent may be defined as
o: the extent of a sentence, which should vary so that the prose does not drag
the mark over a vowel that changes its sound or distinguishes one word from another
an unexpected turn of events that changes the course of the story
the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated
items.s: L'accent: the mark over a vowel that changes its sound or distinguishes one word from another. The other options describe Le pléonasme, La péripétie, La longueur de la phrase.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La péripétie.
o: the position set against the one being defended in a reasoned piece
the choosing of the exact word rather than a vague one that nearly fits
an unexpected turn of events that changes the course of the story
the sentence in the opening that tells the reader the order of the parts to follow
items.s: La péripétie: an unexpected turn of events that changes the course of the story. The other options describe L'annonce du plan, La précision du vocabulaire, L'antithèse.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines L'antithèse?
o: a passage that builds up a person's features, dress, manner and character
the position set against the one being defended in a reasoned piece
the first sentence of a block, which states the point it will develop
a written report of what took place at a meeting, a lecture or an event
items.s: L'antithèse: the position set against the one being defended in a reasoned piece. The other options describe Le compte rendu, Le portrait, La phrase d'ouverture.

items.q: L'antithèse may be defined as
o: the position set against the one being defended in a reasoned piece
a word or phrase such as cependant that shows how two statements hang together
the voice that tells the story, whether or not it takes part in it
the writing out of the corrected draft in its final fair form
items.s: L'antithèse: the position set against the one being defended in a reasoned piece. The other options describe La mise au propre, Le narrateur, Le connecteur.

items.q: The statement “the opening sentence that catches the reader's attention and leads into the subject” describes which of the following?
o: Le développement
Le bilan
La conclusion
L'amorce
items.s: L'amorce is the opening sentence that catches the reader's attention and leads into the subject.
items.t: The three parts of a composition

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le connecteur d'opposition?
o: a linking word such as pourtant that sets one statement against another
the naming of one thing by another to which it is likened, without any word of comparison
a linking word such as donc that gives the result of a statement
the opening sentence that catches the reader's attention and leads into the subject
items.s: Le connecteur d'opposition: a linking word such as pourtant that sets one statement against another. The other options describe La métaphore, L'amorce, Le connecteur de conséquence.

items.q: The statement “the listing of points in order with markers such as d'abord and ensuite” describes which of the following?
o: Le connecteur
Le connecteur de conséquence
Le connecteur de cause
L'énumération
items.s: L'énumération is the listing of points in order with markers such as d'abord and ensuite.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines L'image?
o: the development that makes clear how a reason supports the claim it serves
the five stages of situation, complication, action, resolution and final state
a comparison used to make a description vivid, as a simile or a metaphor does
a particular case brought in to make a general reason convincing
items.s: L'image: a comparison used to make a description vivid, as a simile or a metaphor does. The other options describe Le schéma narratif, L'explication, L'exemple.

items.q: La problématique may be defined as
o: the single point that a block of sentences exists to establish
the central question the writer must answer through the whole piece
the putting right of the faults found in a draft before it is handed in
the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion
items.s: La problématique: the central question the writer must answer through the whole piece. The other options describe La correction, L'idée directrice, Le raisonnement.

items.q: La recherche d'idées may be defined as
o: the opening sentence that catches the reader's attention and leads into the subject
the sentence in the opening that tells the reader the order of the parts to follow
the referring back to something already mentioned instead of naming it again
the stage of collecting facts, examples and opinions to support the argument
items.s: La recherche d'idées: the stage of collecting facts, examples and opinions to support the argument. The other options describe La reprise, L'annonce du plan, L'amorce.

items.q: The statement “the stage of collecting facts, examples and opinions to support the argument” describes which of the following?
o: La recherche d'idées
Le plan
Le brouillon
La répartition du temps
items.s: La recherche d'idées is the stage of collecting facts, examples and opinions to support the argument.

items.q: Which term is described by “a piece that sets out information on a subject in an ordered and neutral way”?
o: L'antithèse
L'exposé
La synthèse
La thèse
items.s: L'exposé is a piece that sets out information on a subject in an ordered and neutral way.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La lettre formelle.
o: a message to an office or a stranger, with a polite opening and a set closing formula
a linking word such as donc that gives the result of a statement
the writing out of the corrected draft in its final fair form
a word or phrase such as cependant that shows how two statements hang together
items.s: La lettre formelle: a message to an office or a stranger, with a polite opening and a set closing formula. The other options describe La mise au propre, Le connecteur de conséquence, Le connecteur.

items.q: Le remue-méninges may be defined as
o: the free gathering of every idea that comes to mind before any of it is arranged
the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument
a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense
the mark over a vowel that changes its sound or distinguishes one word from another
items.s: Le remue-méninges: the free gathering of every idea that comes to mind before any of it is arranged. The other options describe L'accent, Le genre de texte demandé, La faute de conjugaison.

items.q: Le pléonasme may be defined as
o: a comparison used to make a description vivid, as a simile or a metaphor does
the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated
telling in which the teller speaks as je and reports only what that figure knows
a piece of reasoning that looks sound but is in fact faulty
items.s: Le pléonasme: the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated. The other options describe Le sophisme, L'image, La narration à la première personne.

items.q: Which term is described by “the summary of one's findings stated in the closing part”?
o: Le bilan
La transition
L'amorce
L'introduction
items.s: Le bilan is the summary of one's findings stated in the closing part.
items.t: The three parts of a composition

items.q: Which of the following best describes La narration à la première personne?
o: the device of breaking into a story to relate something that happened earlier
the summary of one's findings stated in the closing part
the careful going over of a finished draft to find and remove its faults
telling in which the teller speaks as je and reports only what that figure knows
items.s: La narration à la première personne: telling in which the teller speaks as je and reports only what that figure knows. The other options describe Le bilan, La relecture, Le retour en arrière.

items.q: La concession may be defined as
o: the listing of points in order with markers such as d'abord and ensuite
the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion
the position reached by drawing together the strong points of two opposing views
the admission of a valid point on the other side before answering it
items.s: La concession: the admission of a valid point on the other side before answering it. The other options describe L'énumération, La synthèse, Le raisonnement.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le curriculum vitae.
o: a block of sentences developing one point and set off by a new line
a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense
a written account of a person's schooling, qualifications and experience sent to an employer
the final sentence of a block, which draws its point together
items.s: Le curriculum vitae: a written account of a person's schooling, qualifications and experience sent to an employer. The other options describe La faute de conjugaison, La phrase de clôture, Le paragraphe.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le raisonnement?
o: the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion
the setting described in a passage so as to give the events a background
the place and the period in which the events of a story are set
the use of the same word or structure more than once, which usually weakens a piece
items.s: Le raisonnement: the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion. The other options describe Le décor, La répétition, Le cadre spatio-temporel.

items.q: Which term is described by “the central body of the piece, where the argument is worked out in ordered parts”?
o: Le développement
L'introduction
Le bilan
La transition
items.s: Le développement is the central body of the piece, where the argument is worked out in ordered parts.
items.t: The three parts of a composition

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La demande d'emploi?
o: the position reached by drawing together the strong points of two opposing views
the fixed courteous closing of a letter, such as je vous prie d'agréer mes salutations distinguées
a particular case brought in to make a general reason convincing
a letter written to apply for a post and set out one's fitness for it
items.s: La demande d'emploi: a letter written to apply for a post and set out one's fitness for it. The other options describe La formule de politesse, L'exemple, La synthèse.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La faute d'accord.
o: the position reached by drawing together the strong points of two opposing views
a mistake in matching a describing word or verb with the noun it belongs to
a written report of what took place at a meeting, a lecture or an event
a comparison used to make a description vivid, as a simile or a metaphor does
items.s: La faute d'accord: a mistake in matching a describing word or verb with the noun it belongs to. The other options describe Le compte rendu, L'image, La synthèse.

items.q: The statement “the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument” describes which of the following?
o: Le hors-sujet
Le genre de texte demandé
La problématique
La reformulation du sujet
items.s: Le genre de texte demandé is the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La ponctuation?
o: the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read
a passage that builds up a person's character and habits rather than their looks
the mark over a vowel that changes its sound or distinguishes one word from another
the five channels of perception a description may appeal to, from sight to touch
items.s: La ponctuation: the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read. The other options describe Les cinq sens, L'accent, Le portrait moral.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le bilan?
o: the summary of one's findings stated in the closing part
a shortened version of a text that keeps its main points in their order
the single point that a block of sentences exists to establish
a written account of a person's schooling, qualifications and experience sent to an employer
items.s: Le bilan: the summary of one's findings stated in the closing part. The other options describe Le résumé, Le curriculum vitae, L'idée directrice.
items.t: The three parts of a composition

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le pléonasme?
o: the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read
a written report of what took place at a meeting, a lecture or an event
the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated
the central question the writer must answer through the whole piece
items.s: Le pléonasme: the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated. The other options describe La problématique, Le compte rendu, La ponctuation.

items.q: All of the following belong to Formal writing, letters and summaries EXCEPT
o: La formule d'appel
La formule de politesse
Le dénouement
La lettre formelle
items.s: Every other option belongs to Formal writing, letters and summaries. “Le dénouement” belongs to Narrative writing, not Formal writing, letters and summaries.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le compte rendu?
o: a written report of what took place at a meeting, a lecture or an event
the position reached by drawing together the strong points of two opposing views
the five channels of perception a description may appeal to, from sight to touch
a passage that builds up a person's character and habits rather than their looks
items.s: Le compte rendu: a written report of what took place at a meeting, a lecture or an event. The other options describe Les cinq sens, La synthèse, Le portrait moral.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La demande d'emploi.
o: the final turn in which the complication of a story is settled
the opening address of a letter, such as Monsieur le Directeur
the closing section that gathers the findings and answers the question posed
a letter written to apply for a post and set out one's fitness for it
items.s: La demande d'emploi: a letter written to apply for a post and set out one's fitness for it. The other options describe Le dénouement, La conclusion, La formule d'appel.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La correction.
o: a reason offered in support of the position the writer is defending
the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read
a linking word such as pourtant that sets one statement against another
the putting right of the faults found in a draft before it is handed in
items.s: La correction: the putting right of the faults found in a draft before it is handed in. The other options describe La ponctuation, L'argument, Le connecteur d'opposition.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La correction?
o: the putting right of the faults found in a draft before it is handed in
the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument
a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense
a piece that tells of events that happened, real or imagined
items.s: La correction: the putting right of the faults found in a draft before it is handed in. The other options describe Le récit, Le genre de texte demandé, La faute de conjugaison.

items.q: Which term is described by “the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out”?
o: La recherche d'idées
Le plan
Le plan dialectique
Le plan thématique
items.s: Le plan is the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out.

items.q: The statement “the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read” describes which of the following?
o: La ponctuation
La faute de conjugaison
La correction
La mise au propre
items.s: La ponctuation is the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read.

items.q: La comparaison may be defined as
o: the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion
the bringing together of two things with comme or tel que to show a likeness
a passage that builds up a person's features, dress, manner and character
telling in which the teller speaks as je and reports only what that figure knows
items.s: La comparaison: the bringing together of two things with comme or tel que to show a likeness. The other options describe La narration à la première personne, Le raisonnement, Le portrait.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La progression du texte?
o: the stage of collecting facts, examples and opinions to support the argument
the steady movement of a piece from one point to the next without going back
a piece that tells of events that happened, real or imagined
the central body of the piece, where the argument is worked out in ordered parts
items.s: La progression du texte: the steady movement of a piece from one point to the next without going back. The other options describe Le récit, Le développement, La recherche d'idées.

items.q: The statement “the place and the period in which the events of a story are set” describes which of the following?
o: Le narrateur
La narration à la première personne
Le cadre spatio-temporel
Le retour en arrière
items.s: Le cadre spatio-temporel is the place and the period in which the events of a story are set.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le schéma narratif.
o: the sentence in the opening that tells the reader the order of the parts to follow
a passage that builds up the appearance of a place, a person or a thing
the single point that a block of sentences exists to establish
the five stages of situation, complication, action, resolution and final state
items.s: Le schéma narratif: the five stages of situation, complication, action, resolution and final state. The other options describe La description, L'annonce du plan, L'idée directrice.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le genre de texte demandé.
o: the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument
the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out
a passage that builds up the appearance of a place, a person or a thing
the putting right of the faults found in a draft before it is handed in
items.s: Le genre de texte demandé: the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument. The other options describe Le plan, La description, La correction.

items.q: La description may be defined as
o: a piece of reasoning that looks sound but is in fact faulty
a passage that builds up the appearance of a place, a person or a thing
the fixed courteous closing of a letter, such as je vous prie d'agréer mes salutations distinguées
the first sentence of a block, which states the point it will develop
items.s: La description: a passage that builds up the appearance of a place, a person or a thing. The other options describe La formule de politesse, La phrase d'ouverture, Le sophisme.

items.q: The statement “the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out” describes which of the following?
o: Le plan
Le brouillon
Le remue-méninges
Le plan dialectique
items.s: Le plan is the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le pléonasme?
o: the sentence in the opening that tells the reader the order of the parts to follow
the steady movement of a piece from one point to the next without going back
the setting described in a passage so as to give the events a background
the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated
items.s: Le pléonasme: the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated. The other options describe L'annonce du plan, Le décor, La progression du texte.

items.q: The statement “the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated” describes which of the following?
o: Le registre de langue
La longueur de la phrase
La précision du vocabulaire
Le pléonasme
items.s: Le pléonasme is the fault of stating in one word what another word has already stated.

items.q: The statement “writing that departs from what was asked and so fails to answer the question set” describes which of the following?
o: La reformulation du sujet
Le genre de texte demandé
Le hors-sujet
La consigne
items.s: Le hors-sujet is writing that departs from what was asked and so fails to answer the question set.

items.q: Which term is described by “an unexpected turn of events that changes the course of the story”?
o: La péripétie
Le narrateur
Le schéma narratif
Le retour en arrière
items.s: La péripétie is an unexpected turn of events that changes the course of the story.

items.q: Which term is described by “the extent of a sentence, which should vary so that the prose does not drag”?
o: La répétition
La longueur de la phrase
La précision du vocabulaire
La périphrase
items.s: La longueur de la phrase is the extent of a sentence, which should vary so that the prose does not drag.

items.q: The statement “a comparison used to make a description vivid, as a simile or a metaphor does” describes which of the following?
o: La comparaison
La métaphore
La description
L'image
items.s: L'image is a comparison used to make a description vivid, as a simile or a metaphor does.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le bilan.
o: the summary of one's findings stated in the closing part
the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out
the allotting of the writing period between planning, drafting and checking
the first sentence of a block, which states the point it will develop
items.s: Le bilan: the summary of one's findings stated in the closing part. The other options describe Le plan, La répartition du temps, La phrase d'ouverture.
items.t: The three parts of a composition

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le paragraphe?
o: the opening sentence that catches the reader's attention and leads into the subject
a three-part scheme that sets out a view, then its opposite, then a reconciling position
a block of sentences developing one point and set off by a new line
the development that makes clear how a reason supports the claim it serves
items.s: Le paragraphe: a block of sentences developing one point and set off by a new line. The other options describe L'explication, Le plan dialectique, L'amorce.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La faute de conjugaison?
o: the five channels of perception a description may appeal to, from sight to touch
the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read
a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense
a linking word such as pourtant that sets one statement against another
items.s: La faute de conjugaison: a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense. The other options describe Les cinq sens, Le connecteur d'opposition, La ponctuation.

o: La périphrase
Le pléonasme

o: a linking word such as ainsi that introduces a supporting case
the listing of points in order with markers such as d'abord and ensuite
the referring back to something already mentioned instead of naming it again
a linking word such as car that gives the reason for a statement
items.s: Le connecteur d'illustration: a linking word such as ainsi that introduces a supporting case. The other options describe Le connecteur de cause, La reprise, L'énumération.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains L'objet de la lettre.
o: the fixed courteous closing of a letter, such as je vous prie d'agréer mes salutations distinguées
a message to an office or a stranger, with a polite opening and a set closing formula
the short line stating what a formal message is about
a shortened version of a text that keeps its main points in their order
items.s: L'objet de la lettre: the short line stating what a formal message is about. The other options describe La formule de politesse, Le résumé, La lettre formelle.

items.q: La répartition du temps may be defined as
o: the rough first version written quickly and corrected before the fair copy is made
the stage of collecting facts, examples and opinions to support the argument
the allotting of the writing period between planning, drafting and checking
the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out
items.s: La répartition du temps: the allotting of the writing period between planning, drafting and checking. The other options describe La recherche d'idées, Le plan, Le brouillon.

items.q: The correct meaning of Le sophisme is
o: the showing up of the weakness in an opposing argument
a piece of reasoning that looks sound but is in fact faulty
the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion
the admission of a valid point on the other side before answering it
items.s: Le sophisme: a piece of reasoning that looks sound but is in fact faulty. The other options describe Le raisonnement, La réfutation, La concession.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the listing of points in order with markers such as d'abord and ensuite”
o: Le connecteur d'illustration
L'énumération
La reprise
Le connecteur de cause
items.s: L'énumération is the listing of points in order with markers such as d'abord and ensuite.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La progression du texte?
o: a linking word such as ainsi that introduces a supporting case
a word or phrase such as cependant that shows how two statements hang together
a linking word such as donc that gives the result of a statement
the steady movement of a piece from one point to the next without going back
items.s: La progression du texte: the steady movement of a piece from one point to the next without going back. The other options describe Le connecteur d'illustration, Le connecteur, Le connecteur de conséquence.

items.q: “the mark over a vowel that changes its sound or distinguishes one word from another” is the definition of
o: L'accent
La faute d'accord
La mise au propre
La faute de conjugaison
items.s: L'accent is the mark over a vowel that changes its sound or distinguishes one word from another.

items.q: Les cinq sens may be defined as
o: the bringing together of two things with comme or tel que to show a likeness
a comparison used to make a description vivid, as a simile or a metaphor does
the five channels of perception a description may appeal to, from sight to touch
a passage that builds up a person's character and habits rather than their looks
items.s: Les cinq sens: the five channels of perception a description may appeal to, from sight to touch. The other options describe Le portrait moral, L'image, La comparaison.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La narration à la première personne?
o: the five stages of situation, complication, action, resolution and final state
telling in which the teller speaks as je and reports only what that figure knows
a piece that tells of events that happened, real or imagined
the voice that tells the story, whether or not it takes part in it
items.s: La narration à la première personne: telling in which the teller speaks as je and reports only what that figure knows. The other options describe Le schéma narratif, Le récit, Le narrateur.

items.q: The correct meaning of Le connecteur d'opposition is
o: a linking word such as pourtant that sets one statement against another
the referring back to something already mentioned instead of naming it again
a linking word such as donc that gives the result of a statement
a linking word such as ainsi that introduces a supporting case
items.s: Le connecteur d'opposition: a linking word such as pourtant that sets one statement against another. The other options describe Le connecteur de conséquence, La reprise, Le connecteur d'illustration.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains La répartition du temps.
o: the allotting of the writing period between planning, drafting and checking
a three-part scheme that sets out a view, then its opposite, then a reconciling position
the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out
a scheme in which each main part takes one aspect of the subject in turn
items.s: La répartition du temps: the allotting of the writing period between planning, drafting and checking. The other options describe Le plan, Le plan dialectique, Le plan thématique.

items.q: The correct meaning of Le connecteur is
o: the listing of points in order with markers such as d'abord and ensuite
the steady movement of a piece from one point to the next without going back
a word or phrase such as cependant that shows how two statements hang together
a linking word such as ainsi that introduces a supporting case
items.s: Le connecteur: a word or phrase such as cependant that shows how two statements hang together. The other options describe La progression du texte, L'énumération, Le connecteur d'illustration.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the development that makes clear how a reason supports the claim it serves”
o: La phrase d'ouverture
L'idée directrice
La phrase de clôture
L'explication
items.s: L'explication is the development that makes clear how a reason supports the claim it serves.

items.q: The correct meaning of La ponctuation is
o: a mistake in the form a verb takes for its subject and tense
the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read
the careful going over of a finished draft to find and remove its faults
the mark over a vowel that changes its sound or distinguishes one word from another
items.s: La ponctuation: the marks that divide a piece into sentences and show how each is to be read. The other options describe L'accent, La faute de conjugaison, La relecture.

items.q: L'annonce du plan may be defined as
o: the opening section that announces the subject and sets out how it will be handled
the central body of the piece, where the argument is worked out in ordered parts
the short passage that carries the reader from one main part to the next
the sentence in the opening that tells the reader the order of the parts to follow
items.s: L'annonce du plan: the sentence in the opening that tells the reader the order of the parts to follow. The other options describe L'introduction, Le développement, La transition.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains La reformulation du sujet.
o: the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument
the restating of the question in one's own words to show that it is understood
the word in the question that carries the weight of the demand and governs the whole answer
writing that departs from what was asked and so fails to answer the question set
items.s: La reformulation du sujet: the restating of the question in one's own words to show that it is understood. The other options describe Le genre de texte demandé, Le mot-clé du sujet, Le hors-sujet.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains La réfutation.
o: the showing up of the weakness in an opposing argument
the position reached by drawing together the strong points of two opposing views
the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion
the position a writer undertakes to defend through a reasoned piece
items.s: La réfutation: the showing up of the weakness in an opposing argument. The other options describe Le raisonnement, La synthèse, La thèse.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Le plan.
o: the free gathering of every idea that comes to mind before any of it is arranged
the allotting of the writing period between planning, drafting and checking
the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out
the stage of collecting facts, examples and opinions to support the argument
items.s: Le plan: the ordered list of the parts a piece will contain before it is written out. The other options describe La recherche d'idées, La répartition du temps, Le remue-méninges.

items.q: The correct meaning of Le schéma narratif is
o: telling in which the teller speaks as je and reports only what that figure knows
the five stages of situation, complication, action, resolution and final state
the place and the period in which the events of a story are set
the voice that tells the story, whether or not it takes part in it
items.s: Le schéma narratif: the five stages of situation, complication, action, resolution and final state. The other options describe Le narrateur, Le cadre spatio-temporel, La narration à la première personne.

items.q: “the short passage that carries the reader from one main part to the next” is the definition of
o: L'annonce du plan
La conclusion
La transition
Le bilan
items.s: La transition is the short passage that carries the reader from one main part to the next.
items.t: The three parts of a composition

items.q: “the choosing of the exact word rather than a vague one that nearly fits” is the definition of
o: Le style
La précision du vocabulaire
Le registre de langue
Le pléonasme
items.s: La précision du vocabulaire is the choosing of the exact word rather than a vague one that nearly fits.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Le raisonnement.
o: the position reached by drawing together the strong points of two opposing views
a piece that sets out information on a subject in an ordered and neutral way
the showing up of the weakness in an opposing argument
the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion
items.s: Le raisonnement: the orderly movement of thought from premises to a supported conclusion. The other options describe La réfutation, La synthèse, L'exposé.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le genre de texte demandé?
o: the restating of the question in one's own words to show that it is understood
the central question the writer must answer through the whole piece
the wording set for a piece of writing, which fixes what must be discussed
the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument
items.s: Le genre de texte demandé: the category of writing the task requires, such as a story, a letter or a reasoned argument. The other options describe La problématique, La reformulation du sujet, Le sujet.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La phrase de clôture?
o: the first sentence of a block, which states the point it will develop
the development that makes clear how a reason supports the claim it serves
the single point that a block of sentences exists to establish
the final sentence of a block, which draws its point together
items.s: La phrase de clôture: the final sentence of a block, which draws its point together. The other options describe La phrase d'ouverture, L'idée directrice, L'explication.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains La transition.
o: the short passage that carries the reader from one main part to the next
the sentence in the opening that tells the reader the order of the parts to follow
the opening section that announces the subject and sets out how it will be handled
the central body of the piece, where the argument is worked out in ordered parts
items.s: La transition: the short passage that carries the reader from one main part to the next. The other options describe Le développement, L'annonce du plan, L'introduction.
